chapter_seo_title: RMJi Ch 075: Han Li Fuses Kung Fu & Magic! A Genius Pivot.
chapter_meta_description: Han Li hits a wall with standard spells, so he does what he does best: improvises. He fuses the Wind Riding Technique with the Smoke Step and turns the Fireball into a melee weapon, right as the Wild Wolf Gang shocks the sect with a peace offer.
og_title: RMJi Ch 075: When Immortal Magic Fails, Han Li Builds a Better Mousetrap
og_description: Finding spells impossible due to a lack of materials, the pragmatic Han Li re-engineers his combat arts, creating a deadly fusion of martial techniques and magic.
twitter_title: Ch 075: Han Li’s Combat MacGyver Moment
twitter_description: Frustrated by useless spells, Han Li creates a new combat style by fusing martial arts and magic. A masterclass in Mortal Stream pragmatism.
